title: Frequency Limits on Routine Dental Benefits
content:
Each routine dental benefit under the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders carries its own frequency limit. The limits the rider held carries are set out below; those counted in a benefit year are given as a count, those counted in months as the months that must pass.

## Counted in the benefit year

| Rider | Cleanings | Dental examinations | Bitewing radiograph sets | Fluoride treatments |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 2 | 2 | 1 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 2 | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 4 | 4 | 2 | 2 |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 3 | 3 | 2 | 2 |

Each figure is how many of that benefit the rider pays for in a benefit year.

## Counted in months that must pass

| Rider | Between full-mouth radiograph sets | Before a crown on the same tooth is paid for again | Before a denture is paid for again |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 60 | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 36 | 84 | 84 |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 36 | 60 | 60 |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 36 | 60 | 60 |

Each figure is the months that must pass between one such benefit and the next.

## Points of judgement

**The Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider carries a longer interval between full-mouth radiograph sets than any other rider in the schedule**, at 60 months against the 36 months carried by the Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider, the Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider and the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider.

**Crown and denture replacement intervals move together on every rider that carries them**, at 84 months on the Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider and 60 months on both the Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider and the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider.

**The Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider carries the highest yearly counts in the schedule**, at 4 cleanings and 4 dental examinations against the 2 carried by the Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider and the Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider and the 3 carried by the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider.
